title: The differential tier fails on a listed difference that no longer differs
description: 13 entries in compat/differences.yaml no longer differed and the tier only printed a note, so they went unnoticed; left in, a regression back to the old behaviour would pass. The lead removed the closed gaps (DefaultAudioStreamIndex in two 'flags and counters' entries, HasSubtitles) in D-039's pull request; the rest are deliberate differences and need a verdict. D-039.
acceptanceCriteria: A listed difference the tier finds equal fails the run and names the entry; shown failing on a planted stale entry

Each remaining stale entry gets a verdict and is fixed accordingly: 'sessions during a transcode' (EncodeSpeed, IsBelowRealTime: improvement); the hide-tracks requests for the opted-in viewer (MediaStreams, MediaSources[].MediaStreams: improvement); 'a sign-in with a wrong password' ((status): improvement; LoginAttemptsBeforeLockout: non-goal), whose single wrong password gets 401 from both servers and -1 from both, so the request never shows what the entries describe. A vanished deliberate difference is investigated, not deleted: either the request is changed so the difference shows (and internal/api/signin_test.go's requirement still holds), or the entry moves to a request that shows it, or the loss is brought to the product owner

POST PlaybackInfo with a MediaSourceId in upper-case compact form, in dashed form and as an id of no source are added to test/differential/requests.yaml, as observed on Jellyfin 12.4 during JS-153: the upper-case compact id answers the same on both and is no listed difference; the dashed id (refused by Jellyfin, accepted here) and the unknown id (NoCompatibleStream on Jellyfin, an empty list here) are listed in compat/differences.yaml, each with a verdict and its reason. No answer changes unless a capture shows an app docs/status.md lists as supported sending that form (D-041)
notes: Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): The differential tier against Jellyfin (rule 3).
